title: Repository grade v1
description: What a repository's `grade` entry point writes to {run_dir}/grade.json (docs/repo-evaluation-contract.md §4.2). The repository owns it, so it carries `schema` rather than `schema_version`. `pass` null with empty `errors` is score-only; null with errors is a grader failure. Only `metrics` are aggregated and gated; `details` is stored and never aggregated.
